WITH account_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    acc.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as num_orders
  FROM account acc
  JOIN district d ON acc.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN order o ON acc.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY acc.account_id, d.A3
),
avg_orders AS (
  SELECT AVG(num_orders) as avg_num FROM account_orders
)
SELECT 
  ao.account_id,
  ao.region,
  ao.num_orders,
  ao.num_orders - avg.avg_num as diff_from_avg
FROM account_orders ao
CROSS JOIN avg_orders avg
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
